name: Social Activity Feed with Item Components
summary: Social-style activity feed CodeComponent using Item component system (ItemMedia, ItemContent, ItemActions, ItemTitle, ItemDescription, ItemHeader, ItemFooter, ItemGroup, ItemSeparator). Features Skeleton loading placeholders, ScrollArea for scrollable feed, date-fns format() for timestamps, useArrayState with prepend for new items, useHandler for load-more, grouped by date. Like, Reply, Bookmark action buttons with Badge for action types. 10 demo activities with varied action types (commented, pushed, merged, reviewed). No backend required.
shortSummary: Activity feed with Item components, skeleton loading, date grouping, and action buttons
